name: loomtracer-capture
description: Capture Codex decisions into Loomtracer through the deterministic local CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Record Codex decisions with actor provenance.
interface.longDescription: Installs the loomtracer-capture skill and MCP server. The skill teaches Codex when to preserve a durable organizational decision, how to say what it rests on, what it binds and what undoing it would cost (a choice that binds nothing and is cheap to undo is not a decision, and a request goes to your tracker), and how to call the Loomtracer decision.capture CLI against either a local or shared ledger.
defaultPrompt: Use $loomtracer-capture to record this decision, what it rests on, what it binds and what undoing it costs.
Capture the selected option in Loomtracer.
Query Loomtracer for recent agent captures.
